[[File:Hiroshi AG166.png|thumb|250px|Hiroshi]]
(Japanese: '''ヒロシ''' ''Hiroshi'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG166|Curbing the Crimson Tide!]]''. 

He and his friends were confronted by Red Lightning, who challenged them to a [[Pokémon battle]]. Despite his friends' warnings, Hiroshi accepted and called out his {{p|Poliwag}}. Red Lightning won quickly, however, and scribbled on Poliwag's face afterwards. When he took Poliwag to the [[Pokémon Center]], he ran into {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}, which alerted them to Red Lightning's antics.
